methods.description: Count and name the variables recorded for the same individuals; distinguish one-variable data from paired two-variable data and reject unrelated-group pairing.
Distinguish an observed association from proof of causation; give a believable possible direct explanation or suggest a third factor.
Use the absence of a consistent linking pattern to explain that no association is shown, without assuming every pair of variables must be related.
